title: Electroplating
description: Run a current through a metal salt and the metal comes out on the cathode, a mass set exactly by the charge passed. Unlocks the Electroplating Bath and corrosion-proof casings.

puzzle.goal: A current I runs for t seconds through a bath of a metal of molar mass M whose ions take n electrons each. Write the mass m of metal laid down, F being the charge carried by a mole of electrons.
puzzle.name: Faraday
puzzle.ask: Find m in grams for nickel: M = @{M} g/mol, I = @{I} A, t = @{t} s, n = @{n}, F = 96485 C/mol.
puzzle.method: The charge It, divided by F, is the moles of electrons; n of them make one atom of metal.
